verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams organizes conversations by channel and message threads (ms-teams-docs-8, ms-teams-docs-11, ms-teams-docs-30, ms-teams-docs-34), but independent hands-on reports directly contradict that this makes catching up on busy channels efficient: one team abandoned channels entirely because 'threading truly beggars belief' and used chats instead (ms-teams-comm-19), another notes channel vs. chat threading is inconsistent (ms-teams-comm-13), and users report confusion just identifying threads in the UI (ms-teams-comm-9). Missing for 10: first-party documentation specifically describing thread-based catch-up workflows, and any independent corroboration that threading actually helps admins scan busy channels efficiently.
